_note: Episode 8 version 2 (the new form, as Episode 1 v2). Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (the JSON prompt of pipeline/draw_pick.py, three draws a key, the choice at 3x). 'full' holds each still's JSON prompt; bk_NN = row NN of shots.md; bk_02b is the second close-up of shot 2 (her eyes). 'shots' maps every sentence 0-110 (111 sentences, the storyteller version) to the still it shows; a still's key number is the first sentence it shows under (bk_02b is key 2). Long rows hold more stills, one per beat: bk_05b (key 10, shot 5), bk_07b (key 21, shot 7), bk_10b (key 26, shot 8), bk_10c (key 33, shot 10), bk_14b (key 43, shot 14), bk_21b (key 66, shot 21), bk_21c (key 68, shot 21), bk_26b (key 81, shot 26), bk_32b (key 99, shot 32). Sentence 52 (M's second "Huwag!") re-cuts key 50 through shots_fx 'keys' so the punch lands on the shout. No shot is silent any more (each picture carries a storyteller line), so there are no keys 90+. Shot 37 (trivia card) is not drawn. Rules kept: Kawit only from the BACK of the crowd (backs, hats, trays, the hammock, the lens); never the window, the flag, a drum, open hands pushing toward us or a crowd parting from the front; the earlier Indio only tiny inside the lens circle (bk_14). Mabini is a generic thin man, no likeness, carried in a hammock, lying or half-seated, never standing, never comic. M wears period clothes and a salakot (as Episode 3) and her face IS seen (bk_02b, bk_19); she wears no coat and no medallion of her own here, so only the family medallion is in the picture. The red umbrella appears only folded and only from bk_30. Indio has no medallion (M took it in Episode 6): five indigo lines until bk_26, six from bk_27 on. The voice of Sulayman is light only (bk_24): no figure, no face. The lens (lente) string is from story/ep07_v2/shots.md ('an old lens with a gold rim'; through it 'tinted warm and slightly curved'), because videos/ep07v2-ang-sulat-ni-lolo/key_prompts.json has no prompts yet: when Episode 7 v2 draws its lens, copy its exact words into look_cast.cast.lente and lens_view here before drawing. Writing in pictures, added in code after the choice: bk_36 the episode's question ("Ikaw, ka-Indio: kung isang hakbang na lang pauwi, at may nagsabing \"huwag muna\", makikinig ka ba?") in the bare upper wall, about 8% to 40% of the height, clear of the subtitle band at 63%. Nothing else is written: the tally marks of bk_04 and bk_36 are marks drawn by the model (groups of five, no numerals; the count is not meant to be read), the map of bk_32 and bk_33 is coastlines and dots with no labels, the phone screen of bk_35 is a plain glow, the sheet of bk_31 is blank. Negative for every draw: flat cel shading, flat even lighting, cartoon, tv animation, thick even outlines, poster, clip art, text, letters, numbers, watermark, extra fingers, flag, window, drum, balcony, modern buildings, electric wires, weapons, blades.

bk_32b.subject: Eye-level medium close-up: a calm young Filipina woman in her twenties with long straight black hair tied low at the nape, a tired gentle face, dark eyes, a wide woven salakot hat, wearing a plain faded indigo baro blouse, a long dark patadyong skirt and a dark brown cotton shawl over her shoulders, thin dark cloth gloves, holding a folded red umbrella with a thick carved dark wooden handle, closed and tied against her shoulder, looking straight at the young man beside her, calm and kind, making an offer; his shoulder soft at the edge of the picture. Her face in the upper half of the picture.
bk_32b.setting: a dusty yard in Kawit, Cavite, on the afternoon of 12 June 1898, the crowd soft and out of focus behind; no flag, no modern buildings
bk_32b.light: low amber late-afternoon sun, long blue shadows, dust and flour motes in the air, warm rim light, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork
bk_32b.note: shot 32, second beat (key 99): M offers to take him home; the umbrella folded
